The court ruling against FDA overreach is a major victory for medical innovation and patient access. Labs shouldn’t be strangled by bureaucratic red tape that drives up costs and delays critical diagnostics. 

H.R. 1463, the Freedom for Laboratory Innovation and Testing Act, is exactly the kind of legislation needed to rein in out-of-control regulators who prioritize control over real-world outcomes. The FDA’s power grab would’ve forced labs to divert resources into compliance paperwork instead of advancing cutting-edge testing—classic D.C. inefficiency. 

This isn’t just about regulations; it’s about whether life-saving breakthroughs get bogged down in a maze of government approvals. The ruling proves that when accountability hits, overreach loses. Now let’s pass Finstad’s bill to lock this win into law and keep bureaucrats from resurrecting their failed power plays.
